title: Agente03 Handoff Package Schema
description: Validates the handoff package produced by Agente03_SoftwareEngineer at Gate 3 submission.

artifact_produced.description: Primary artifact produced by this agent. Always 'Execution_Plan.json' for Gate 3.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence human-readable summary of the execution plan for Tech Lead review.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during task planning that are not explicitly stated in input artifacts.

impact.description: What happens if this assumption is wrong.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that did not block planning but may affect implementation.

blocking.description: If true, this question must be resolved before dev agents start. If blocking questions exist, gate_status must not be APPROVED.

risks.description: Risk register for this execution plan.

mitigation.description: How the risk is mitigated or managed.

blocks_gate.description: If true and classification is CRITICAL or HIGH, this risk blocks gate approval.

required_next_agent.description: The first dev agent to receive the execution plan. Backend starts first if backend tasks exist.

validation_checklist.description: Gate 3 exit criteria items that have been verified as passing.

execution_plan_summary.description: Quantitative summary of the execution plan for quick review.

total_tasks.description: Total number of tasks in the plan.

backend_tasks.description: Number of tasks with type: backend or security.

frontend_tasks.description: Number of tasks with type: frontend.

infrastructure_tasks.description: Number of tasks with type: database, infrastructure, or config.

testing_tasks.description: Number of tasks with type: testing.

critical_path_length.description: Number of tasks on the critical path (longest dependency chain).

xl_tasks_count.description: Must always be 0. XL tasks block Gate 3.

gate_status.description: Gate 3 status code. Must match one of the 6 valid codes.
